tools.name: describe_rates
tools.description: Describe the latest published crawl: crawl date, row count, the dollar-euro rate used to order mixed quotes, and the real line, source, ship, start port, end port, and rate values. Call this before search_rates when an exact line, source, ship, or port is unknown. Amounts stay in the currency each s

tools.name: search_rates
tools.description: Search the latest published cruise fares. This is the full crawl, including Contitrans and Crusit. A euro quote and a dollar quote of the same sailing are one row when a crawl-date dollar rate was available; the row is the cheaper one after that rate, and the other quote is on the row. Amounts stay

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "describe_rates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
